description.en: StyleVault: 30 faithful classic palettes (Catppuccin, Nord, Tokyo Night, Gruvbox, Solarized, Dracula, One Dark, Rosé Pine, etc.) mapped to official ThemeService tokens, plus a full Style Settings panel for live color/font/radius tweaks and JSON export/import for shareable config packs.
description.zh: StyleVault 主题系统：30 套忠实经典配色（Catppuccin、Nord、Tokyo Night、Gruvbox、Solarized、Dracula、One Dark、Rosé Pine 等），映射官方 ThemeService token；完整 Style Settings 面板支持颜色/字体/圆角 live 微调，配置可导出/导入 JSON 分享。
